text:
I had my wisdom tooth extracted here, and the post-extraction service was terrible.
After the extraction, I experienced ear congestion for four days. The clinic scheduled a follow-up appointment. When I arrived, the doctor's attitude was very unpleasant. She implied that I had eaten something wrong or done something that was causing the ear congestion. After the examination, before I even left the room, I overheard staff members talking amongst themselves, implying it was my fault and that it wasn't related to the tooth extraction. They even suggested I see an ENT (Ear, Nose, Throat) specialist if the problem persisted. I was extremely uncomfortable with this experience. I will not be using their services again. The doctor who examined me was a woman.

text:
Had an annual check-up here to monitor my teeth and make sure they’re doing well 1 year ago. The dentist at the time wasn’t particularly friendly, but I don’t mind as long as they do a good job.

Despite specifically asking for only a checkup, they insisted on doing teeth cleaning too, which I had an appointment for at another dentist anyway. So I had to have this done and paid for it, despite not needing it.

After she finished looking around, I asked her to give me an update and tell me about my teeth health. She just responds ‘If there was anything wrong, I would tell you’, which was unnecessarily rude. Anyway, I just had another checkup a year on. I had to have one filling and they identified both sets of wisdom teeth (left and right) need to be taken out. They said due to the size of the infection in my wisdom teeth it has been around for about 2 years.

Maybe this dentist was having a bad day… but whoever it was, hopefully they can be more attentive to customers!

Let me share my experience with filling a gap here. In 2020, I had a male doctor do it. He was very good, thorough, and gentle. It took 3 years for the gap to fall out, as is normal with age.

So I came back to have it done here again in mid-2024. This time, a female doctor did it. During the procedure, she chatted constantly. She didn't do it carefully. The tooth didn't come out beautiful, natural, or smooth. It fell out after a month. I went back to get it fixed, but it fell out after 7 days. It was so frustrating. It cost almost 4,000 baht.

So I went to another clinic and had it done again. I found that every doctor's skill really varies. 🥹

And most importantly, the female doctor here isn't very nice. I wasn't impressed at all.
